mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We are seeing temperatures around 60 degrees with foggy conditions near the Verona Area High School under a third quarter moon.

In city news, the Verona Senior Center is currently offering free tri-shaw bike rides, which is a great way to enjoy the scenery on the Military Ridge State Trail. Additionally, the city is offering a rain barrel rebate program to help residents reduce stormwater runoff.
You have plenty to choose from today, including yoga at Insight Wellness and a free concert at Century School Park, plus there is live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard starting tomorrow.
In our weekly police report, on July 31, an officer conducted a traffic stop that resulted in the driver being arrested for an O W I, alongside citations for suspended registration.
Today's delicious flavor is Chocolate Caramel Twist. Please note that Culver's is currently closed but will open its doors at 10 AM, so you can grab your treat later today.
